question.question_text: Select the correct statement regarding time duration of different events in the video

answer_options.text: Preparing and cooking the meal and cleaning up after the meal took the same amount of time.
Managing personal items took longer than arranging books and stationery.
The kitchen was organized in a shorter time than the breakfast activities with the man.
Both activities of eating the meal with the man and cleaning and storing kitchen items afterwards had equal time durations.
Arranging books and stationery took longer than managing personal items.

shared_investigation.established_facts: The video contains observations of cooking, eating, and cleaning activities, but no explicit time durations are visible. The evidence does not provide any direct or indirect indication of the time taken for any of the activities described in the answer options.
shared_investigation.gap_reason: The evidence does not include any time duration measurements or visual cues that could be used to determine the relative time durations of the events described in the answer options.
